neighbours.label: ' due' in 'This <trend> is partly/largely due to the fact that', explaining a trend stated in the previous sentence (broad, weak unit)
fire: Attendance at village churches has dropped sharply over the past decade. This decline is partly due to the fact that young families are moving to the cities.
Honey yields in the region have fallen for five years in a row. This drop is largely due to the fact that wild meadows are being ploughed up.
More teenagers are learning to code than ever before. This growth is partly due to the fact that schools now lend laptops to pupils.
Bus ridership in the suburbs keeps shrinking each year. This pattern is mainly due to the fact that parking downtown has become cheaper.
Fewer students are choosing to study foreign languages at university. This shift is partly due to the fact that translation software has improved.
Bookshops in small towns are closing at an alarming rate. This trend is largely due to the fact that readers order online.
Coastal villages are losing residents faster than inland ones. This difference is partly due to the fact that fishing no longer pays well.
Sales of vinyl records have climbed steadily since 2010. This revival is partly due to the fact that collectors value the artwork.
quiet: Attendance at city theatres has dropped sharply over the past decade. This decline worries the owners, who fear that young families will never return.
Apple yields in the region have fallen for five years in a row. This drop has forced many growers to plough up their orchards.
More pensioners are learning to swim than ever before. This growth surprised the council, which now opens the pool earlier.
Tram ridership in the suburbs keeps shrinking each year. This pattern means that fares downtown will become more expensive.
Fewer students are choosing to study ancient history at university. This shift happened after the department lost its best lecturers.
Bakeries in small towns are closing at an alarming rate. This trend shows that shoppers now buy bread at supermarkets.
Mountain villages are losing residents faster than lowland ones. This difference is clear from the latest census figures.
Sales of board games have climbed steadily since 2010. This revival pleases the designers, who value face-to-face play.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (5.0% of tokens reach 0.1 of max) and gate-closed (leak regime 100%); top examples mix ' said' in attributions, ' due', Korean 게/것은. Probes: one two-sentence 'This trend is partly due to the fact that' item reached 0.58; short 'he said' / 'due to' sentences and a long attribution stayed at 0.08-0.19. The label rests on one probe and covers one of several top-example families; the breadth may defeat the near misses.
